scope: All current rows; four already approved shape summaries; no new model inputs or row filtering.
method: For each computable row and fixed observed x coordinates, slopes/curvature are linear functions a dot y. Exact independent per-point ordinate-box bound=sum(abs(a_i)*b_i), using original per-point reading_bound_pp. Peak possible indices satisfy upper_i>=max_j lower_j. Bounds are deterministic sensitivity sets, not SD,CI,noise distributions or physical uncertainty truth.
limits: No horizontal-coordinate/calibration uncertainty propagated; no independent error assumption or MonteCarlo. Slope/curvature conditional on unchanged x/half assignment. No claim that perturbation produces a physically realizable full curve.
report: Retain all rows and flag unidentifiable signs without rejecting records. Check extreme ordinate vectors reproduce both analytic extrema. No training or changes to author targets.
